annotations.title: Speech to text, transcribe audio: Whisper transcription of an audio file

description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL, or uploaded in a POST body, using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count; subtitles=srt or vtt adds subtitle text and timestamps=true adds timed segments and words. Accepts common formats such as MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG up to 5 MB, in 90+ languages. Use for voice notes, podcast clips, meeting snippets, subtitles and voice messages. Example: url=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/En-us-hello.ogg. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, sv or de (default: detected)

subtitles.description: srt or vtt: also return subtitle text

timestamps.description: true: also return timed segments and words

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of an audio file (max 5 MB); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)

name: transcribe
